svg.title: Saved-snapshot replay workflow
svg.desc: An intended workflow from original earlier feeds through Lab and frozen CP2, then later feeds and Oracle diagnosis, Evolve review, and a later matched comparison. The current example stops at preparation of the first reasoning request.

svg.text: Synthetic System A: measurements, subsystems, context, events, interventions and derived summaries.
Current synthetic example: inputs loaded; first reasoning request prepared; no forecast yet.
Oracle explains the frozen forecast against later truth; only a separate matched comparison can assess a reviewed change.
